intent: A precise, monochrome ⌘K command palette: it opens in a staggered cascade over its own trigger, with fuzzy matches marked by a highlighter-pen accent, full keyboard control and correct combobox ARIA.

stack.fonts: font-sans (Geist) for labels and input, font-mono (Geist Mono) for group labels, hints, keycaps and footer

layout.root: @container, relative; the caller gives it a height (the demo: max(720px, 100dvh) on #0a0a0b). Holds the trigger, the scrim, the palette and the toast; no fake app behind it.
layout.trigger: 48px field centred 64px from the top (96px from a 672px container), max-w 640px: field fill, 1px line border, inset highlight, search icon + 'Search or jump to…' + ⌘ K keycaps
layout.scrim: covers the root: black at 55% (light: #f4f4f5 at 60%) with a 2px backdrop blur; click to close
layout.palette: opens over the trigger: max-w 640px, inset 12/24px, top 56/88px, solid panel (no glass), radius 16px, 1px line border, inset top highlight, shadow 0 24px 80px -12px black/90%
layout.search: 60px row: 18px icon, borderless input, esc keycap (from a 512px container)
layout.results: max-h min(400px, 100dvh - 240px); groups with mono labels, a rule between groups; rows ≥44px, radius 10px: 28px icon tile, label, hint, shortcut keycaps (from 512px)
layout.footer: 44px, ink at 2%: ↑↓ navigate, ↵ open, esc close; live result count right
layout.keycap: 22px, radius 5px, 1px line border, field fill with inset highlight, mono 11px muted

color.palette: PALETTE.dark / PALETTE.light written to --cp-* CSS variables; theme prop picks one
color.dark: panel #111113, field #141416, line #232327, rule #1c1c1f, ink #f4f4f5, body #c4c4ca, muted #a1a1aa, faint #8a8a93, tile #1b1b1e, hover white/6%, press white/10%
color.light: panel #ffffff, field #fafafa, line #e4e4e7, rule #efeff1, ink #18181b, body #3f3f46, muted #52525b, faint #71717a, tile #f1f1f3
color.selected: hover-tint row with a 3px accent marker on its left edge; the icon tile inverts to ink with a panel-coloured icon
color.accent: one prop, default #ff7a45: the selection marker, and the highlighter behind matched characters (accent at 30% via color-mix, text stays ink). Nothing else is coloured.
color.toast: ink pill with panel-coloured text and a check

motion.tokens: EASE_OUT [0.22,1,0.36,1], EASE_IN [0.4,0,1,1], SPRING_UI 500/40; every duration lives in one MOTION object
motion.firstView: once 20% in view the trigger rises 10px out of an 8px blur (420ms); 160ms later the palette opens
motion.open: every open replays the cascade: panel from y −10px, scale 0.98 and an 8px blur (320ms, origin top); search row at 50ms; then each group label and row in reading order from a 6px rise and blur, 25ms apart from 100ms, capped at 10 so long lists never drag (360ms each); footer last. Whole open lands by ~800ms.
motion.typing: rows that appear as you type settle from a 3px blur in 180ms, without a stagger
motion.exit: y −6px, scale 0.985, 4px blur, 160ms ease-in; scrim fades
motion.selection: one highlight and the accent marker glide between rows on a shared layoutId (spring.ui)
motion.choose: the chosen row flashes (scale 0.985, press tint) for 130ms, then the palette closes and focus returns to the trigger
motion.toast: ink pill rises 12px out of a blur, holds 2.2s; every timer is cleared on re-schedule and unmount
motion.reducedMotion: 150ms opacity fades only; no marker travel, no press delay
motion.press: rows 0.99, trigger 0.99, esc keycap 1px down; empty state's icon and two lines stagger in

responsive.narrow: palette 12px from the edges, input 16px (no iOS zoom), keycaps and esc hidden
responsive.@lg (512px): palette 24px from the edges, input 17px, shortcuts and esc visible

accessibility: input is role=combobox with aria-controls, aria-expanded, aria-autocomplete=list, aria-activedescendant
results role=listbox; groups role=group labelled by headings; rows role=option with aria-selected
↑/↓ wrap, Home/End, Enter runs, Esc clears then closes; focus stays in the input
⌘K/Ctrl+K toggles; focus returns to the trigger on close; trigger has aria-keyshortcuts
result count and empty state are polite live regions

Recent: CSV export drops the last row · OPS-412

avoid: glass panel (the scrim may blur; the palette stays solid)
moving DOM focus into the list
a fake app or skeleton behind the palette
coloured icon tiles or a colour per group
the whole palette dropping in as one block
